message: The optional-module catalog (.engine/provisioning/module-catalog.json) is a derived-committed artifact: it is generated from the module manifests' presentation records and must never be hand-authored. This check regenerates it from those manifests and compares; if the committed file was hand-edited or left stale after a presentation change, it goes red. To fix it, regenerate with `uv run --directory .engine -- python tools/module_catalog.py generate` and commit the result.
